sublevels.coverPrompt: Create ONE polished educational slide cover background in a 16:9 landscape canvas, 1600x900. Image 1 (German students) and image 2 (Polish student) are the STRICT STYLE REFERENCES. Match their friendly rounded modern storybook/vector cartoon characters: simple solid black oval eyes, tiny white highlights at most, button noses, rosy round cheeks, simple broad smiles, chunky sculpted hair shapes with only 2–3 large locks, soft minimal dimensional shading, smooth illustrated surfaces. Use the German reference's character design language, NOT the realistic-haired Japanese anime look. SCENE: Japanese A1.1 first lesson about learning hiragana vowels. Two Japanese student friends sit at a small low learning table with an open book and exactly five BLANK colored flashcards, happily introducing the cards. Boy: simple short straight black hair, teal sweatshirt; girl: simple straight black bob, warm yellow sweatshirt. Human proportions and faces should look like the German reference group, with moderate rounded heads and small simple eyes. Quiet simplified Japanese terrace, one small Japanese wooden pavilion at far right, a few rounded shrub shapes at the bottom edge. Spacious calm background, no dense foliage or texture. All people and objects are in the BOTTOM 42% of the image. The TOP 55% is uninterrupted calm rich teal-blue sky to place a white title later, no text built into image. Primary accent Linguo teal #1A9E9E with warm cream and soft coral/yellow. Full-bleed finished illustration. No text, no writing, no logo, no watermark, no collage. Avoid anime, manga, glossy large irises, hair strands, eyelashes, bishonen faces, photorealism, fussy shading, dense architecture. Beautiful professionally art-directed simple cute cartoon, consistent with both supplied references.
